Name: Stale guest accounts report
Description: Lists guest accounts with no interactive or non-interactive sign-in within the chosen number of days, including guests that never redeemed their invitation. Read-only. Needs Entra ID P1 or higher for sign-in activity.
Author: M365 Admin Toolkit

Parameters.Name: IncludeNeverSignedIn
Parameters.Label: Never signed in
Parameters.HelpText: Include guests with no recorded sign-in at all
